[Girl]
La la la la~
I feel so good today~
I'm in the mood to go
on a picnic somewhere~
La la la la~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
啦啦啦啦~
今天心情真好~
好想找個地方野餐~
啦啦啦啦~

scripts.text: About Luoyang.
scripts.translation: 關於洛陽

scripts.text: Go to Luoyang.
scripts.translation: 去洛陽

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh, are you
interested in Luoyang?
It's a nice place to
visit for travelers.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦，你對洛陽感興趣？
那裡可是個旅行的好去處。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Luoyang has a long history
with stories of ancient magic and warriors. It's also rumored that many evil beasts roam the
Luoyang area.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
洛陽曆史悠久，流傳著古代法術和武人的故事。
聽說這一帶還有不少邪惡的猛獸出沒。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You can find cure-all medicines, mysterious occurrences, and
martial artists all in one place!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
靈丹妙藥、奇聞異事、武林高手，這裡都有！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I used to train in the martial arts every morning back when I was in Luoyang. I might not look like it, but I'm pretty strong!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我以前在洛陽，每天早上都練武。
看不出來吧？我可是很厲害的！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
If you want to visit
Luoyang, feel free to
tell me. Just give me
some Zeny and we'll go~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
想去洛陽，儘管告訴我。
付點Zeny就能出發~

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I'll guide you to
Luoyang right away.
For my service, I am
accepting 10,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
帶你去洛陽需要10,000 Zeny，付好就能出發。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
那麼，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Okay~
Ready!
Have fun!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
好~準備出發！
玩得開心！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
...
You don't seem
to have 10,000 Zeny...
Go get some money first!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
...
你好像沒有10,000 Zeny...
先去弄點錢吧！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh...
It's so disappointing
to hear you say that.
Well, have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦...
聽你這麼說，真有點失望。
那祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh...
Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦...
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Would you
like to go back
to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你想回艾爾貝塔嗎？

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I hope to
see you again!
Bye bye!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
希望下次還能見到你！
再見！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
If you like this
area, why don't you
stay and enjoy the
the food and the sights!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
喜歡這裡的話，就多待一會兒，品嚐美食、欣賞美景吧！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
And by sights...
I mean girls!
Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
所謂美景嘛...
就是這裡的姑娘啦！嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Girl]
And the boys here
aren't bad looking~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
這裡的男孩們長得也不賴哦~

scripts.text:
[Zhi Ching Li]
All the members of the Maiden Palace, including myself and our master, are all female.
scripts.translation:
[支青麗]
包括我和師父在內，少女宮的所有成員都是女性。

scripts.text:
[Zhi Ching Li]
Recently we've had a hard time recruiting new members, so I came here to check if there's any woman who wishes to join us.
scripts.translation:
[支青麗]
最近很難招到新成員，所以我來這裡看看，有沒有姑娘願意加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Zhi Ching Li]
...

[Zhi Ching Li]
...
......

[Zhi Ching Li]
Please leave me
alone, I'm busy.
scripts.translation:
[支青麗]
請別打擾我，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
I am practicing my 'Claw of Dragon.' I not only need to use the power of my fists, I must also condition myself spiritually.
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
我正在練龍爪功，既要鍛鍊拳勁，也得修煉心神。

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
Every martial art requires
spiritual training since the
mind controls the body.
If you've trained yourself spiritually, you can easily
use any part of the body!
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
心神駕馭身體，所以任何武學都離不開心性修煉。
心神練好了，才能自如運用身體各處！

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
If you are considering
studying the martial arts, you should first attain knowledge before jumping into the
physical training.
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
想學武的話，先學明白道理，再開始練功。

scripts.text:
[Akiira]
Learn about the martial arts
and meditate on life's truths. First, you must find peace of mind before you can hope to master the mind and body.
scripts.translation:
[阿基拉]
研習武學，靜思人生真諦。
先讓內心平靜，才有望掌握身心。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
Finally...
I have mastered
the 'Claw of Dragon!'
scripts.translation:
[張曉吉]
終於...
我練成龍爪功了！

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
Although there are eight basic steps, I had to learn the history of this art, and meditate, focusing on my spiritual improvement,
for three years.
scripts.translation:
[張曉吉]
雖然只有八式，我還是先學了這門功夫的歷史，靜坐修心，整整花了三年。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
After that, my master finally started to give me the physical training so I could use the eight steps of the Claw of Dragon. I've devoted myself to this art for thirty years.
scripts.translation:
[張曉吉]
之後，師父才開始教我練功，施展龍爪功的八式。
這門功夫，我足足練了三十年。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
I'm very proud that I've
mastered this art ten years earlier than I expected. Now, I need to study this form and improve it by correcting its weak points and enhancing its strengths.
scripts.translation:
[張曉吉]
比預計早了十年練成這門功夫，我很自豪。
接下來還要鑽研招式，彌補不足，發揚長處。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
I guess that would take me about ten years. But I'm not disheartened by that at all.
scripts.translation:
[張曉吉]
大概又要十年吧，不過我一點也不灰心。

scripts.text:
[Zhiang Xiau Ji]
When you're learning a martial art, you can't rush yourself and learn everything in a short period of time. It's impossible! Plus, that isn't the essence of art...
scripts.translation:
[張曉吉]
學武不能急於求成，妄想短時間內學會一切，那是不可能的！
那也不是武學的真諦...

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
歡迎光臨。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
This is an elevator which leads
to the Observation Tower. We are providing you a safe and fast transfer service for an affordable fee. Would you like to use this service?
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
這部電梯通往觀景塔。
我們以實惠的價格，提供安全快捷的升降服務。
您要乘坐嗎？

scripts.text: Information.
scripts.translation: 服務說明

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
After many suggestions and proposals were sent to the Luoyang tourism office, the Observation Tower was built so tourists can enjoy the sights.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
洛陽旅遊局收到許多建議，於是建起觀景塔，方便遊客欣賞風景。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
Due to the geographical
features of Luoyang, it's difficult to enjoy the breath taking view that our land has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
洛陽的地形特殊，令人難以盡覽這裡的壯麗景色。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
You can come up to the tower by taking the elevator right here. We are providing this quick and safe transfer service for 500 zeny per person.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
搭乘這裡的電梯，就能上觀景塔。
服務安全快捷，每人收費500 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
I'm sorry, but you do not have enough zeny. I hope you'll come back later to enjoy the Observation Tower. Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
歡迎備足費用後再來遊覽觀景塔。
祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
Thank you for your patronage.
We are trying to provide you with the best of service. Please
come again.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
感謝您的惠顧。
我們會努力為您提供最優質的服務，歡迎再次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Hong Miao]
Please come
back later.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[洪淼]
請稍後再來。
祝您愉快。
